tools.name: list_permissions_skill_files
tools.title: List Permissions Skill Files
tools.description: List the files in the platform 'permissions' skill, the platform's guidance for access control and sharing inside an app. Call this when the user asks about checking the current user's role or access level, gating UI by permission, listing a project's or engine's members, sharing an app or engine with other users, editing or revoking member access, approving or denying access requests, or pushing project permissions down to its engine dependencies, and when they name getUserProjectPermission, getUserEnginePermission, getProjectUsers, getEngineUsers, addProjectUserPermissions, editProjectUserPermissions, removeProjectUserPermissions, approveProjectUserAccessRequest, denyProjectUserAccessRequest, propagateUserPermissions, or the OWNER/EDIT/READ_ONLY/DISCOVERABLE roles. Returns each file with its path, name, and description so you can read only what you need; start with SKILL.md. Not for login or auth bootstrap (see the app-bootstrap skill).

project.title: project
project.description: The permissions skill (permissions). Always this value.

tools.name: read_permissions_skill_file
tools.title: Read Permissions Skill File
tools.description: Read one file from the platform 'permissions' skill in full, for writing code that manages access and sharing through the @semoss/sdk REST helpers (these are plain async functions that throw on failure, not pixels). Pass filePath exactly as list_permissions_skill_files reports it; SKILL.md is the main guide and covers the Role levels, gating UI by the current user's permission, listing and paging members, the search-then-grant sharing flow, editing and revoking access, access requests, the admin flag, and propagating project permissions to engine dependencies.

project.title: project
project.description: The permissions skill (permissions). Always this value.

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Path of the file to read, relative to the skill folder, as reported by list_permissions_skill_files. Use 'SKILL.md' for the main guide.
